title: H^n of closed and open balls of an n-plane centred on the plane (step 0(c))
statement: Let N, n ∈ ℕ, T ∈ G(N,n), a ∈ T.plane and r > 0. Then H^n(T.plane ∩ B_r(a)) = unitBallVolume n · (ofReal r)^n and H^n(T.plane ∩ B°_r(a)) = unitBallVolume n · (ofReal r)^n (equalities in [0,∞]; H^n = μHE[n], unitBallVolume n = volume of the open unit ball of EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)). Notation: H^n := μHE[n]; G(N,n) := Grassmannian N n; p_S := Grassmannian.project S (orthogonal projection onto S.plane); t_P(S) := ‖LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap(projectionLinearMap S − projectionLinearMap P)‖ (operator norm of p_S − p_P); μ_W := W.weight; ‖δW‖ := variationMeasure W; v(T) := planeVarifoldMeasure T; B_ρ(y) := closedBall y ρ, B°_ρ(y) := ball y ρ; unitBallVolume n is the extended-real volume of the open unit ball of ℝ^n; ofReal := ENNReal.ofReal.
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (T : Grassmannian N n) (a : Euclidean N) (r : ℝ), a ∈ T.plane → 0 < r → (μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N)) ((T.plane : Set (Euclidean N)) ∩ closedBall a r) = unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal r ^ n ∧ (μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N)) ((T.plane : Set (Euclidean N)) ∩ ball a r) = unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal r ^ n
